newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's commercial tv welcomes EU television vote.
newsitem.headline: EU's commercial tv welcomes EU television vote.

text.p: The European Union's commercial television stations welcomed on Wednesday the European Parliament's climbdown over revisions to the EU's broadcadsting legislation.

The parliament abandoned on Tuesday calls for binding quotas on the number of Hollywood programmes shown on European television along with demands to extend the EU's 1989 television without frontiers directive to new media services.
It also backed down from demands for tougher restrictions on advertising on television.
The Association of Commercial Television in Europe (ACT) said the demands, if they had come into effect, "would have damaged the current and future prospects of the European audiovisual sector."
